SELECT vo.id AS id, vo.order_no AS orderNo, vo.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, vo.voucher_id AS voucherId, v.title AS voucherTitle, m.name AS shopName, vo.pay_amount AS payAmount, vo.status AS status, vo.payment_status AS paymentStatus, vo.payment_method AS paymentMethod, vo.order_source AS orderSource, vo.pay_deadline AS payDeadline, vo.use_deadline AS useDeadline, vo.pay_time AS payTime, vo.use_time AS useTime, vo.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, vo.create_time AS createTime FROM `voucher_order` vo LEFT JOIN `user` u ON vo.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `voucher` v ON vo.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN `merchant` m ON v.merchant_id = m.id
ORDER BY vo.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `voucher_order` vo LEFT JOIN `user` u ON vo.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `voucher` v ON vo.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN `merchant` m ON v.merchant_id = m.id

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(vo.pay_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(AVG(vo.pay_amount), 0) AS avgOrderAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN vo.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usedOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN vo.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN vo.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN vo.status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN vo.order_source = 'seckill' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seckillOrders FROM `voucher_order` vo LEFT JOIN `user` u ON vo.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `voucher` v ON vo.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN `merchant` m ON v.merchant_id = m.id

SELECT DATE(vo.create_time) AS day, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(vo.pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM `voucher_order` vo WHERE vo.create_time >= #{startTime} AND vo.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(vo.create_time) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT vo.voucher_id AS voucherId, v.title AS voucherTitle, COUNT(1) AS useCount FROM `voucher_order` vo LEFT JOIN `voucher` v ON vo.voucher_id = v.id WHERE vo.create_time >= #{startTime} AND vo.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY vo.voucher_id, v.title ORDER BY useCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
